quallaSearch.notes: Started with the local published story media and all 41 candidate records. Inspected public-domain-labelled LOC historic exterior and 1928 painting: obsolete awnings/paint obscure surviving entrance geometry and exact underlying primary grant was not bound, so excluded. Public-domain interiors/mosaic/plaque do not control the exterior. Relevant former selected exteriors require attribution. Only then obtained two exact NPS original photographs with explicit full public-domain grants.

originalReview.notes: Native original individually inspected. Both photos show the western gable with the Custom House behind; file names are acquisition labels, not elevation labels. Main wider view resolves recessed doors alternating with arched ground-floor windows, fanlights and pale surrounds. Closer view controls white window trim and gable detail. Dark winter illumination is not an exact color standard. Neighboring buildings, statues and temporary furniture excluded.
